# A trial that nothing will end

`Tool: tol-trial-no-criteria` `TRIAL`

## What we use it for

Collecting traces in one service, as an evaluation rather than as a commitment.

## Status

**trial**, with no `## Trial criteria` section beneath it. That is what `trial-has-criteria` reports: nothing here
says what is being measured or what would settle the question either way, so the status never has to change.
